chronicles.desc: … had a lot of great …, but none was greater than … of ….
chronicles.name: Most Valiant of …

chronicles.desc: … was a truly great … venerated by all.
chronicles.name: Ancestral Glory

chronicles.desc: A wanderer no more. A Conqueror was born from an indomitable soul.
chronicles.name: The Greatest Conqueror

chronicles.desc: QA is an ancestral and noble profession
chronicles.name: The Legend of QA

chronicles.desc: Few bearing the name of … have done so much for their dynasty as ….
chronicles.name: A Mighty Endeavor for …

chronicles.desc: Guided by … faith in …, … has led the faithful … to victory over the …, led by the vile …
chronicles.name: The Spiritual Triumph of …

chronicles.desc: There is nay a soul in … that does not know the name of … and … accomplishments.
chronicles.name: … True Hero

chronicles.desc: Throughout all history, among all rulers of …, none has achieved so much, none shall be spoken about before the great ….
chronicles.name: Great Deed for …

chronicles.desc: By the will, strength, and cunning of …, … has come to existence and shall never falter!
chronicles.name: Foundation of …

chronicles.desc: … was raised by a …, and that rugged experience out in … creation made … divinely equipped to rule.
chronicles.name: … Child

chronicles.desc: At the jousting fields of …, the ultimate contestant … has won the tournament for the third time. No living soul on Earth could rival ….
chronicles.name: Three Victories of …

chronicles.desc: Against all odds, … has repelled the hordes of ….
chronicles.name: A Valiant Defense

chronicles.desc: … has rightfully conquered … from the unworthy ….
chronicles.name: Conquest of …

seeds.desc: Corineus, ancient Trojan warrior, was the original founder of Cornwall. He came to Britannia and slew the giants occupying the area and named the place Cornwall after himself.
seeds.name: The Ballad of Corineus

seeds.desc: Rodrigo Díaz de Vivar was once a dishonored lesser nobleman, now turned a king of his own.
seeds.name: The Song of El Cid

seeds.desc: A great holy warrior, this hero has valiantly fought for their faith.
seeds.name: The Holy Fist

seeds.desc: Brutus, banished from Troy, was guided by Diana to Albion. After defeating the great giants that occupied the land, he founded Troia Nova, the town we now know as London.
seeds.name: New Troy

seeds.desc: Born from the womb of a dragon goddess, and descended from Mahasammata, we have the holiest and mightiest of blood carried through our line.
seeds.name: Heirs of the Dragon Goddess

seeds.desc: King of Danes and slayer of a mighty wyrm, … was a terror to Christians and a legendary adventurer. … great deeds in life are too many to name, and with … blood flowing through me, it is only right that I claim … legacy and build a legendary tale all my own!
seeds.name: Sons of Loðbrók

seeds.desc: General, conqueror, and usurper, Bahram Chobin took the Sassanid throne for himself, and his heroic blood flows through our veins.
seeds.name: Descendant of Bahram Chobin

seeds.desc: On his son's seventh birthday, Piast the Wheelwright was visited by two strangers. As thanks for his hospitality, the strangers cast a spell making the Piast cellar eternally full.
seeds.name: The Cellar of Plenty

seeds.desc: Vercingetorix once united the Gallic tribes in a rebellion against the Roman invasion. Though he fell at Caesar's hand, his Celtic spirit lives on in our blood.
seeds.name: Heirs of Vercingetorix

seeds.desc: … weathered the invasions of the Northmen in England, and stood as a bulwark and proselytizer for Christendom.
seeds.name: The Holy King

seeds.desc: Murdered and buried without honors, Edward the Martyr's body was found to be incorrupt after a year. It is said that he embraced his own death out of a deep love for Christ.
seeds.name: Edward the Martyr

seeds.desc: Holding a sacred site for … is a mark of holiness itself.
seeds.name: … of the … Holy Site

seeds.desc: Beta Israel is the legendary Jewish kingdom that continues to fervently resist Christianization. We are descended from the Tribe of Dan who fled Israel during the civil war between the forces of Rehoboam and Jeroboam.
seeds.name: Kings of Semien

seeds.desc: The Naga are holy half-human and half-serpent creatures who reside in Patala, and can occasionally cross into our world as full humans. Our family can trace their lineage back to a Naga who once visited Kashmir and laid with a human.
seeds.name: Blood of the Naga

seeds.desc: The ancient Lombardic king Sceafa crawled out of the sea as a child and went on to rule England. We know he was the grandson of Noah, and it is from him we gain our divine blood.
seeds.name: Sceafa, Grandson of Noah

seeds.desc: A paragon of humility and piety, the heroic King Shibi was tasked with protecting the sage Agni who had been transformed into a bird. When a kite demanded he sacrifice his own flesh to save the dove, Shibi gave his whole self willingly, but was spared and rewarded with his son Kapotaroma. It is the blood of this selfless king that runs through the veins of every ….
seeds.name: Shibi Chakravarti

seeds.desc: Defeater of the Islamic armies in Orange, Guillaume Gellones was a warrior for Christendom and founded the abbey in Gellone where he would later retire from rule as a monk and retire there.
seeds.name: La Prise d'Orange

seeds.desc: The magnificent king of Turan and hero of the Turks, Afrasiyab was the nemesis of the Persian Empire and the greatest of all Turanian kings. His magical blood flows through our veins and gives us the divine right to rule Turan once again.
seeds.name: The King of Turan: Afrasiyab

seeds.desc: Bahram Gur was a great warrior king who fought and resisted countless invaders. His blood flows through our veins, making us Persian heroes.
seeds.name: Gur Lineage

seeds.desc: Alan Gua, the mother of all …, was visited by a strange glittering figure every day and night. Like a great yellow dog, he crawled into her yurt via the moonbeams at night and the sunbeams at day, and gifted her with three sons. She warned her divinely conceived sons that they must stick together like a bundle of five arrows or be broken like five lone arrows.
seeds.name: The Glittering Visitor

seeds.desc: Cadell began life as a slave boy, and with the blessing of a Saint bestowed upon him, he wrestled the Powys kingdom from Vortigern.
seeds.name: The Blood of Cadell

seeds.desc: The great king Charlemagne once ruled this land before this dynasty, who claim to be direct descendants of his imperial blood.
seeds.name: The Heirs of Charlemagne

seeds.desc: We are the sons and daughters of the Gods. Brahman, Vishnu, our blood can be traced back to the beginning of time itself.
seeds.name: Blood of Brahman

seeds.desc: The Goths brought about the destruction of Rome and founded our Kingdom. We are their heirs, the Kings and Queens of the Goths.
seeds.name: Gothic Kings

seeds.desc: Fjolnir, founder of the Yngling dynasty was produced from the loins of Gerðr in her love of Freyr. Who else but Fjolnir's offspring could possess the divine blood necessary to rule Norway?
seeds.name: Hieros Gamos

seeds.desc: Our people can trace our lines back to the families of the Huns, and the founder of our dynasty was in fact the ferocious Attila who brought Rome to its knees.
seeds.name: Hunnic Heritage

seeds.desc: The once and future king lives on through the blood of this dynasty.
seeds.name: The Legacy of Arthur Pendragon

seeds.desc: The founder of our dynasty, Menelik I, was the product of the love between Solomon of Israel and the Queen of Sheba.
seeds.name: Sons of David

seeds.desc: Basil was born to peasant farmers and entered the employ of the Emperor before marrying his daughter and ascending to the rank of Basileus himself.
seeds.name: From Peasant to Basileus

seeds.desc: Our ancestor began life as a mere peasant in the village of Stadice, but he soon caught the eye of Libuše and married her to become Prince of the Czechs.
seeds.name: Přemysl the Plowman

seeds.desc: Our family does not merely rule in a modern Roman Empire, we have been influential courtiers in Rome since the days of the Republic.
seeds.name: Roman Heritage

seeds.desc: It is from Scota, daughter of a great Egyptian Pharaoh, that we call our land "Scotland". She is the mother of all Scots, and it is the blood of the ancient Pharaohs that flows through our veins.
seeds.name: Sons of Scota

seeds.desc: David, King of Israel, was ordained by God and his blood runs through the veins of every ….
seeds.name: Heirs of David

seeds.desc: The Varangian Prince Rurik took his adventuring horde east and established the great Kingdom of Novgorod. It is his legendary blood that flows through our veins.
seeds.name: Sons of Rurik

seeds.desc: It is said that in Ireland's early days, a promise was made that the first to lay their hand on Ulster would be given claim to it, and be made High King of Ireland. It was our ancestor who had the wit to slice off his own hand and hurl it into Ulster, staining the emerald grass with his blood.
seeds.name: The Red Hand of Ulster

seeds.desc: The blood of the last Sassanid shah runs through our veins. Though … was besieged by Turks, Khazars, and Arabian invaders from all sides, … remained loyal to Persia to … final breath.
seeds.name: Blood of … III
